name: Etunimitilasto (Digi- ja väestötietovirasto), Finland
note: Every given name in the Finnish population information system with five or more
bearers, by sex and with counts.
CC BY 4.0, recorded by the avoindata.fi catalogue as `license_id: cc-by-4.0`.
Attribution-only, so nothing conflicts with Apache-2.0 distribution.
The URL carries the extraction date, so DVV publishing a new edition changes the URL
rather than the file. That is the good failure: re-pinning is a deliberate act, and a
stale pin keeps building the corpus it built yesterday instead of silently changing
everyone's fixtures. The dataset's resource id is stable if the URL ever has to be
